facts.title: SetFit type results (pilot 400 steps and partial 1500 run, mean AP 0.8384, 0.77 ms/story) are INVALID: I relaunched setfit without CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=, so it ran on the GPU (nvidia-smi showed PID 1330934 with 4126 MiB) in breach of the no-GPU rule; the first run (CPU, 'no accelerator' warning, 8.9 s/step) was the right setup. Killed by verified PID; files renamed *-GPU-INVALID in data/suite/setfit/. The 0.8384 and the speed must not be used. Encoder per suite.py: intfloat/e5-small-v2 via SetFit (body-weight change and train/test overlap NOT checked). R-0121 and R-0124 stay unscored. Fix: every suite launch sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= (e5ft jobs 1328280/1328281 are not on the GPU per nvidia-smi: torch tensors stay on CPU).

Drift audit (T-0024), both reviewers: no recorded reason for leaving SetFit/model2vec untrained, for not retraining topic/story type/country after rounds 1-2, or for retiring the e5 country classifier (q1-q3 <= 0.12 both); the three readers that were dropped by test (detection features, phrase map, fine-tune only in ensemble) are backed (q4-q6 >= 0.72 both); both say labelling started before the definition check (q8) and training ran on criteria both asked to revise (q9); C9 counted passed with open decisions (q11 0.71/0.91); calibration shares its fit set with thresholds (q13 0.88/0.95); coverage fails (q16 0.03 both). Route both fill-gaps-then-continue. Split: main gap (local shared-calibration-fit, hosted jev-only-reference), trust (partial-and-unverified vs trustworthy-with-gaps), q7 Jev-error risk (0.38 vs 0.86)
Scorecard ensemble + isotonic calibration: 5/50 criteria pass (10%); Country 4/11; Story type 0/10; Scope/focus 0/9; Topic 0/10; Conditions 1/10

Isotonic calibration per key (fitted on night1 held-out 2,000, scored on testA): K8 0.76 -> 0.80 (bar 0.90), probability bands become near honest from 0.5 to 0.8 (true share 0.53 / 0.56 / 0.71 / 0.76); K6 17 -> 19 of 48 keys within 2.5 false alarms per 1,000. The calibration set is small (few positives per key), so the top band stays coarse

Ensemble condition reader on testA (thresholds set on night1 held-out): K6 false alarms <= 2.5 per 1,000 on 17 of 48 keys (median 2.97 per 1,000; median precision 0.44, recall 0.56); K8 calibration: 76% of p >= 0.9 predictions are true (bar 90%), and every band runs high (0.5-0.6 -> 15% true, 0.8-0.9 -> 53%) because class-balanced training inflates probabilities

Fine-tuned e5-small (CPU, 2 epochs, 10k stories, 13.7 min, 9.2 ms/story) ties the frozen e5+tfidf reader on the frozen test: mean AP 0.438 vs 0.436 on 48 keys; better on 23; but the two differ strongly per key (9 keys beyond 2 noise SD, 5 each way), so they are complementary.
